faq.q: Do I need to label a social image as AI?
faq.a: Follow the platform’s current labeling rules when you post an AI image. Requirements vary by platform and location.

faq.q: How much does a social ad image cost?
faq.a: Each image costs 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I put a headline on the image?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short headline that shoppers can read on a phone. You can also put the headline in the ad text instead.

faq.q: How can I make social posts that stand out?
faq.a: Start with a clear product photo and a ready-made scene, then add a short message. Try different backgrounds or colors to see what catches attention.

faq.q: How often should a small shop post?
faq.a: Choose a schedule you can keep, then reply to comments. One product photo can become several posts with different scenes.

faq.q: Can one product photo make several social posts?
faq.a: Yes. Make several scenes from one product photo and compare them in your posts or ads. You do not need a new shoot.

faq.q: What kinds of social posts work best?
faq.a: Posts with a strong product photo and a clear opening often get attention. Try posts that show, teach, or entertain, then compare the results.

faq.q: Where can I use a square social ad image?
faq.a: Use it in square feed posts and ads on platforms that accept that size. Check your text in each placement before posting.

more_sections.lead: You can finish a square without a designer on staff. Start from the cutout and stop when the product looks right.

items.t: Add Light and a Soft Shadow
items.d: A soft shadow sits the product on the surface, so it stops looking like it floats.

items.d: Name the room, the street, or the season, and get a background that fits the product you uploaded.
The uploaded item is placed into the setting you described. It is not redrawn as a different product.

definition.title: What Is a Social Ad Image?
paras: A social ad image turns one product photo into a square the feed can run. Reuse one scene and the shop stays recognizable from post to post.
When a holiday is the right moment, drop the product into a frame that already has the border. Then add the offer in your own words.
